title: Letter and Cipher
author: Mara Yarrow
blurb: Ivo Blackwood, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the trial begins.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
